state.description: Comments keyed by `<issueId>/<commentId>` (prefix scan per issue); parentId marks a one-level reply.
Cycles keyed by id (read-only in v1); isActive/isFuture/isPast and progress are rendered from virtual time and the team's issues.
Index keyed by identifier (`ENG-12`) → issue id, written together with the issue row.
Issues keyed by id; identifier is <TEAMKEY>-<number>; archived issues are excluded from lists unless includeArchived.
Issue labels keyed by id; teamId null = workspace label; names unique within their scope; archived labels cannot be applied; groups cannot be applied directly.
Single row `counters`: nextId (run-time ids 00000000-0000-4000-8000-<hex>) and lastSyncId (bumped by every mutation).
Single row `organization`: the workspace (urlKey builds every url; gitBranchFormat builds branch names; optional `limits` override the documented scan bounds).
Projects keyed by id; teamIds (≥ 1) decide visibility; status is rendered from state; slugId is 8 hex chars.
Teams keyed by id; key unique upper-case; memberIds is the membership; issueCount is the last issued number; private teams are visible to members only.
Workspace users keyed by id; email unique (case-insensitive); admin/guest flags are the roles; active:false = suspended.
Workflow states keyed by id; names unique per team; ordered by position.

operations.description: Add a comment to a visible, non-archived issue. GraphQL spelling: { input: CommentCreateInput { issueId, body, parentId } }; flat spelling: issueId, body, parentId (one-level replies only). Emits comment.created.
Comments of one visible issue (Linear `comments`): issueId (id or identifier) or filter: { issue: { id: { eq } } }; orderBy createdAt|updatedAt (descending), paging. Only issue comments exist.

mcp.name: list_comments
mcp.description: List comments on a Linear issue

operations.description: Create (issueId to start a thread, or parentId to reply) or update (id) a comment with the official save_comment argument names.

mcp.name: save_comment
mcp.description: Create or update a comment on a Linear issue. If `id` is provided, updates the existing comment; otherwise creates a new one.

operations.description: Replace a comment's body (author or admin only). GraphQL spelling: { id, input: { body } }; flat spelling: { id, body }.

Cycles of a team ordered by number (Linear `cycles`): teamId or team (id/key/name) plus type current|previous|next, or filter: { team: { id: { eq } }, isActive/isFuture/isPast }. A team with cycles disabled returns an empty connection.

mcp.name: list_cycles
mcp.description: Retrieve cycles for a specific Linear team

operations.description: Execute one GraphQL document (query or mutation with variables and operationName) against the implemented subset: the `POST /graphql` route. Selection sets are projected from the same rows as the semantic operations; fields outside the subset fail NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
Archive an issue by id or identifier (Linear `issueArchive`); trash:true is rejected; sub-issues are not archived. Emits issue.updated with updatedFields ["archivedAt"].

Create an issue. GraphQL spelling: { input: IssueCreateInput (teamId, title, description, stateId, assigneeId, priority, estimate, dueDate, labelIds, projectId, cycleId, parentId, sortOrder) }; MCP spelling: team, title, description, state, assignee, priority, estimate, dueDate, labels, project, cycle, parentId. Emits issue.created.

One visible issue by id or identifier (e.g. ENG-12) with children, labels, creator, url, branchName and one page of its comments, oldest first (`commentsFirst` 1–250, default 50; `commentsAfter` = the previous `pageInfo.endCursor`; same order and cursor scope as GraphQL `issue(id) { comments(first, after) }`).

mcp.name: get_issue
mcp.description: Retrieve detailed information about an issue by ID, including git branch name

operations.description: Issues visible to the caller (Linear `issues` / `searchIssues`). MCP spelling: query, team, state, assignee ("me", "null"), priority, label, project, cycle, parentId, createdAt/updatedAt (after), includeArchived, fields, limit/cursor/orderBy; GraphQL spelling: filter (IssueFilter subset), first/after/orderBy/includeArchived. One spelling per call.

mcp.name: list_issues
mcp.description: List issues in the user's Linear workspace. For my issues, use "me" as the assignee. Use "null" for no assignee.

operations.description: Create (no id; team and title required) or update (id) an issue with the official save_issue argument names: team, title, description, state, assignee ("me" or null), priority, estimate, dueDate, labels | addLabels/removeLabels, project, cycle, parentId.

mcp.name: save_issue
mcp.description: Create or update a Linear issue. If `id` is provided, updates the existing issue; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `team` and `title` are required.

operations.description: Update an issue by id or identifier. GraphQL spelling: { id, input: IssueUpdateInput (labelIds replaces, addedLabelIds/removedLabelIds adjust; null clears assigneeId/projectId/cycleId/parentId/dueDate/estimate) }; MCP spelling: id plus title, description, state, assignee, priority, estimate, dueDate, labels, addLabels, removeLabels, project, cycle, parentId. Emits issue.updated when something changed.

Create a workspace label (teamId absent; admins only while restrictLabelManagementToAdmins) or a team label. GraphQL spelling: { input: IssueLabelCreateInput }; MCP spelling: name, color, description, teamId or team, isGroup, parent/parentId.

mcp.name: create_issue_label
mcp.description: Create a new Linear issue label

operations.description: Issue labels (Linear `issueLabels`): workspace labels plus the labels of visible teams; team narrows to that team's labels and workspace labels; name substring; filter (IssueLabelFilter); includeArchived. includeGroups:true is rejected (groups are always returned, marked isGroup).

mcp.name: list_issue_labels
mcp.description: List available issue labels in a Linear workspace or team

operations.description: The workspace (Linear `organization`): name, urlKey, userCount, teamCount (teams visible to the caller), gitBranchFormat.
One visible project by id, name or slugId (`query`), or by `id`, with one page of its visible unarchived issues (`issuesFirst` 1–250, default 50; `issuesAfter` cursor; `pageInfo`).

mcp.name: get_project
mcp.description: Retrieve details of a specific project in Linear

operations.description: Projects visible to the caller (Linear `projects`): query (name substring), team, state (name or type), lead, member ("me" allowed), filter (ProjectFilter), includeArchived, createdAt/updatedAt (after), paging (limit ≤ 50 for the MCP spelling).

mcp.name: list_projects
mcp.description: List projects in the user's Linear workspace

operations.description: Create (no id) or update (id) a project. GraphQL spelling: { input: ProjectCreateInput } / { id, input: ProjectUpdateInput }; MCP spelling: name, description, summary (accepted, not stored), state, priority, lead, addTeams/removeTeams/setTeams, startDate, targetDate, icon, color. Guests cannot create or update projects; the caller must be a member of one of the project's teams.

mcp.name: save_project
mcp.description: Create or update a Linear project

operations.description: One visible team by id, key or name (`query`), or by `id`, with its workflow states, team labels and default issue state.

mcp.name: get_team
mcp.description: Retrieve details of a specific Linear team

operations.description: Teams visible to the caller (Linear `teams`): query (key/name substring), filter (TeamFilter), includeArchived, createdAt/updatedAt (after; ISO date-time or duration such as -P1D), paging.

mcp.name: list_teams
mcp.description: List teams in the user's Linear workspace

operations.description: One user by id, name, displayName, e-mail or "me" (`query`), or by `id`.

mcp.name: get_user
mcp.description: Retrieve details of a specific Linear user

operations.description: Workspace users (Linear `users`). MCP spelling: query (name/displayName/email substring), team, limit/cursor; GraphQL spelling: filter (UserFilter), first/after; includeDisabled shows suspended users.

mcp.name: list_users
mcp.description: Retrieve users in the Linear workspace

operations.description: The calling user (Linear `viewer`) with isMe, admin/guest flags, organization and the visible teams the user belongs to.
Workflow states of one team ordered by position (Linear `workflowStates`): team (id/key/name), teamId, or filter: { team: { id: { eq } } }.

mcp.name: list_issue_statuses
mcp.description: List available issue statuses in a Linear team

connections.title: Linear GraphQL client (API URL + personal API key)
connections.instructions: Point the client at LINEAR_API_URL (the GraphQL endpoint is LINEAR_API_URL/graphql) and send LINEAR_API_KEY as the raw `Authorization` header value, the way a Linear personal API key is sent. `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (the OAuth shape) is not accepted. Only the documented GraphQL subset exists; every other path answers 404.

connections.title: Linear MCP server tool names (list_issues, save_issue, get_issue, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to LINEAR_MCP_URL with LINEAR_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Seventeen tool names of the official Linear MCP server are exposed as aliases next to the canonical linear.<operation> names; the official server itself is not the client being run.
